name: Evolution Songwriter
help: Orange Tree Evolution. In Kontakt: set every articulation to Keyswitch (momentary, not latching); Chords mode Disabled (we strum and roll ourselves; never use the pattern or strum keys); Setup: Vibrato CC #1, Legato range 2 ST, Mapping octave Standard. Save a Kontakt snapshot so the auto-assigned keys stop moving. Write the keyswitch test and check each articulation sounds while its key is held: the auto-assigned keys can re-pack when you change trigger types, so re-check the map after converting. Optional: assign a Bypass Legato Key (lets strums ring). Narrow "range" to the keys Kontakt colours as playable. Map predicted from the latching capture; play the keyswitch test once to confirm. Songwriter: performance effect keys start at E5 (88).
